text:
maya: anyone up for a midweek ramen + retro arcade crawl next weds? small group, low-pressure. 7:30pm start? :ramen:
noah: i'm down. which ramen place were you thinking?
ryan: ichiban on 3rd has a solid veggie broth. count me in.
zoe: i can only do 8pm onward, fyi.
lisa: love this. i'll bring a power bank + some quarters for the arcade. :coin:
maya: ok notes: meetup 7:30 at lobby, walk to ichiban (8pm res?), then head to Pixelcade after for a few games. who needs a later start?
noah: i'll call ichiban tomorrow to check for a table for ~6.
ryan: heads up i need gluten-free options — does ichiban have gf noodles?
maya: they do a rice-noodle bowl and we can get extra tofu. i'll confirm when i call.
office-bot: Event created: "Ramen & Retro" — Wed 7:30pm. RSVP here: https://intranet/events/ramen-retro (auto-post)
zoe: if we do 8pm reservation, can we meet 7:45 in lobby? otherwise i may be late.
maya: sure — let's make it 7:45 then.
lisa: budget note: ramen ~$12, arcade tokens $5-10. i'll Venmo for table if needed. @maya send total.
eve: i'm in! bringing a friend.
noah: reservation confirmed: Ichiban 8:00pm table for 6, ref #3821.
maya: sweet. final RSVP so far: maya, noah, ryan, zoe, lisa, eve = 6 (might be 7 with guest). anyone else? @here :raised_hands:
ryan: can someone bring cash for tokens? card machines at Pixelcade are spotty.
lisa: i'll bring cash.
oah: reminder — watch the 9pm bus if anyone's taking transit, later trains run ~every 30 mins.
maya: perfect. see you all wed! low-key, fun night. :sparkles:
